name: Rubik's Official 3x3 (Next-Gen)
description: The original 3x3 Rubik's Cube is back with a fully redesigned mechanism to invite a new generation of solvers into the world of Cubing. While holding true to its iconic look, this version has been re-engineered for a smoother and more responsive play experience. The internal mechanics provide a consistent tension and improved corner-cutting, allowing for faster and less resistant turning.
